title: The Grunion Run, xx
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twentieth year. The run is smaller; the fish are fewer; the town is half lockboxes. The strip counts the lanterns.

panels.composition: The beach, the run. Fewer lanterns — the strip draws exactly eleven. GULLY's thermos line, short. WOOD. BARNABY II in the surf, fewer fish.

image.prompt: a night beach with exactly eleven lanterns and a short coffee line, a thin man with a pad, a three-legged dog in a thin scattering of silver fish, clean ink with a muted wash
image.notes: Count the lanterns: eleven. In 1998 there were dozens.

image.prompt: close-up of a man counting lanterns under his breath, a friend correcting him

panels.composition: The pad: the beach, the lanterns, drawn as a row of twelve small lights along a dark line. Almost a graph.

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad with twelve small lights drawn along a dark line, spare, like a chart of something

panels.composition: Silent. The fish, fewer. The lanterns, twelve. The pup, the same as ever. Wood, pad closed.

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel with twelve lanterns, a thin scatter of silver fish, a three-legged dog, a man with a closed pad, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: Twelve lanterns. The run thinning. The strip counts.
